key: Induction Machine Direct Torque Control with Space Vector Modulator
title: Induction Machine Direct Torque Control with Space Vector Modulator
text: 带 SVM 的感应电机 DTC 结构，输入 6 路、输出 2 路；按 {Axis prioritization} 指定电压限幅器的轴优先级；{Stator resistance (Ohm)} 指定电阻、{Number of pole pairs} 指定极数、{Inverter dc-link voltage threshold (V)} 指定电压、{Fundamental sample time (s)} 指定 SVM 采样时间 5e-6、{Control sample time (s)} 指定 PI 采样时间 5e-5、{Switching frequency (Hz)} 指定开关速率、{Flux controller proportional gain} 指定磁通 PI 比例增益、{Flux controller integral gain} 指定磁通 PI 积分增益、{Flux controller anti-windup gain} 指定磁通 PI 抗积分饱和增益、{Torque controller proportional gain} 指定转矩 PI 比例增益、{Torque controller integral gain} 指定转矩 PI 积分增益、{Torque controller anti-windup gain} 指定转矩 PI 抗积分饱和增益，按实例取值。
